findings.title: Deleting cache leaves the displayed status stale
findings.body: The delete mutation only invokes an optional `onSuccess` callback and does not invalidate `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`. When no callback is provided, the mounted query retains the deleted cache’s `cacheUpdatedAt`, so the dropdown continues to report cached data and offer deletion after the operation succeeded. Invalidate or refetch the connected-calendars query after deletion.

findings.title: Legacy cache rows are reported as updated at migration time
findings.body: Adding this column with `DEFAULT NOW()` assigns the migration timestamp to every existing cache row. The UI presents `updatedAt` as the cache’s last-updated time, so all pre-existing caches appear freshly updated on deployment even when their contents are older. Backfill a timestamp derived from the existing cache metadata, or avoid presenting the migration-time value as the actual update time.

findings.title: The existing-URL update only works with BSD sed
findings.body: `sed -i ''` uses BSD/macOS syntax. On GNU/Linux, when `.env` already contains `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL`, this command treats the empty argument as a file operand and fails to update the value; because the script does not stop on that failure, it can still print that the file was updated. Use a portable in-place edit or branch on the platform.
